groups:
  - name: harbor-slo
    rules:
      - alert: HarborFastBudgetBurn
        expr: |
          (sum(rate(harbor_requests_total{outcome="error"}[5m]))
           / clamp_min(sum(rate(harbor_requests_total[5m])), 1e-9)) / 0.001 > 10
        for: 5m
        labels: {severity: page}
        annotations:
          summary: "Harbor error budget is burning faster than10x"
